description: Carry ranking of ~38 currencies vs a funding currency: policy-rate differential in pp (sorted desc), 1-year FX change vs the funder where official fixings exist, flag when a central bank changed rates in the last 60 days. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

funding.description: Funding currency (ISO 4217, e.g. JPY, CHF, EUR) or ISO2 country; default JPY

name: carry_ranking
